as_told.title: Ben Rich UCLA speech: 'take ET home'

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Ben Rich, the former head of Skunk Works, the secret aircraft design unit of the company Lockheed, once said: "We now have the technology to take ET home," meaning the ability to fly an alien visitor back to the stars. In one telling Michels places this as the closing line of a 1993 speech at UCLA, a university in Los Angeles, and says several people who were there remember it. If true, it would mean the US quietly holds technology for travel between stars.
